english_title: Convolution of Dual Lebesgue Exponents Is Uniformly Continuous, Bounded, and Vanishes at Infinity
statement_en: If $f\in L^p$ and $g\in L^{q}$ with $1/p+1/q=1$ and $p\in[1,+\infty]$, then $f*g$ is uniformly continuous and bounded, and moreover belongs to $C_0$.
key_techniques: approximation by compactly supported continuous functions
callout_body: $f\in L^p,g\in L^{q}$其中$1/p+1/q=1,p\in[1,+\infty]$那么$f*g$一致连续且有界，并且属于$C_0$。
